label: YouTube Explainer
description: Information-dense tutorials and explainers; energetic when useful, patient during demonstrations.
intent: Help viewers understand and remember an idea, not just stay visually stimulated.
avoid: cutting away during an essential on-screen step
full-screen motion while explaining a dense concept
opening: State the question and show what the viewer will know or be able to do.
editing: One idea per beat; synchronize narration and demonstration; keep complex diagrams visible long enough to parse.
typography: Visual hierarchy: topic, key phrase, supporting label; highlight only one concept at a time.
sound: Quiet background music optional; leave high speech intelligibility and avoid overlapping explanation with stings.
critique: Can a first-time viewer actually follow the argument and the demonstrated steps?

creative_contrast.when: A new idea, action or visual fact arrives
The viewer needs to read, understand or feel something
